purpose: Define the narrow, offline transforms that can be reproduced from the declared candidate vocabulary input. The transforms create candidate consumer-shaped data only; they do not authorize an HTML rewrite or establish semantic authority.

profiles.known_transform: Deep-copy candidate terms, relations, and sources without filtering or relabeling.
Deep-copy candidate terms and relations without filtering or relabeling.

Map each term only from named input fields: id, first plain name (or first technical name only when plain is empty), cluster, purpose, status, accountability, function statement, lower-cased de-duplicated aliases from the selected name set, and optional prov. Map each relation to [source,target,type].

known_unknowns: The existing embedded datasets cannot be reproduced exactly from the current candidate input: they omit terms, preserve historical statuses, use historical source lists and three historical definitions.
The historical Canon selection, its ten non-input ids, and its light/status policy have no declared materialization profile here.
No transform validates definitions, provenance, review status, source availability, UI behavior, or STP accepted state.
next_acceptance_gate: A human must approve a target projection policy for each consumer (inclusion, field selection, status treatment, source treatment, and Canon scope), then a separate change may update one consumer plus its exact output receipt and UI corpus evidence.
